firstPlayerRule: The player who lives closest to water starts and takes the Starting Player tile.
clarifications: After the starter’s turn, players take turns clockwise.
The Starting Player tile does not change during the game; its role is to help track the turn order.
internalEvidence: Lookout Games lists the 2008 English rules on its Le Havre product page. A complete original Lookout booklet preserved by a rulebook archive was inspected at rendered PDF page 4. uncertainty: The rules give no tie procedure for equally close homes.
